action.name: Multiattack
entries: The boneclaw makes two Piercing Claw attacks.

action.name: Piercing Claw (Reach 15 ft.)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 8} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 3d10 + 4}) piercing damage, pulls target up to 15 feet, and target is {@condition grappled} (escape {@dc 14}).

action.name: Shadow Jump {@recharge 5}
entries: Each creature within 5 feet must make a {@dc 14} Constitution save or take 34 ({@damage 5d12 + 2}) necrotic damage. Teleports up to 60 feet bringing one grappled creature.

reaction.name: Deadly Reach
entries: In response to a visible enemy moving into its reach (15 ft.), makes one Piercing Claw attack; if it hits, makes a second attack.
